guide.title: Guide
guide.subtitle: Follow these steps to claim and manage your domain.
guide.step1.title: 1. Check availability
guide.step1.desc: Enter your preferred domain on the homepage. We validate the format and check every managed domain to confirm whether the name is available.
guide.step2.title: 2. Create your record
guide.step2.desc: Create an account, log in, and add the IPv4 address you want to point to. Records are written directly to our nameserver and loaded few minutes later.
guide.step3.title: 3. Manage changes
guide.step3.desc: Visit the dashboard whenever you need to update or delete a domain. Every change keeps your zone files in sync automatically.
guide.tip: Most DNS changes become visible worldwide within 5 minutes. If you need advanced settings, reach out through the Help page.
